metadata.title: Meta, Tesla, and chip stocks decline as AI trade comes under pressure: AlphaCheck

content.text:
Good morning. Stocks declined on Thursday as semiconductor names fell, with the AI trade coming under pressure following quarterly results from Meta (META) and Tesla (TSLA).
Shares of the EV maker declined more than 1%, while Meta sank 6%.
The Tech (XLK) sector fell, led by chipmakers like Nvidia (NVDA) and AMD (AMD). Memory makers Micron (MU) and SK Hynix (SKHY) also dropped as the chip sector reversed gains from Wednesday.
Shares of the wafer equipment maker Lam Research (LRCX) fell as much as 10% after management pointed to "supply chain constraints," heading into 2027.
Here's a check of the markets in the first few minutes of trading, based on a heat map powered by Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace data.
Brent crude oil futures (BZ=F) jumped to a five-month high at $111 per barrel while WTI (CL=F) traded near $98 after a report of possible US and Israel attacks on Iran after the November mid-term elections.
Here are some other notable stocks that Yahoo Finance readers are viewing this morning: IBM (IBM), Lockheed Martin (LMT), and The Proctor & Gamble Company (PG).
